v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.en: The Lord hath reigned * let the earth rejoice. ‡

text.la: Te decet hymnus, * Deus, in Sion. ‡
text.en: A hymn, O God, * becometh thee in Sion. ‡

text.la: Tibi, Dómine, psallam, * et intéllegam in via immaculáta.
text.en: I shall sing to thee, O Lord * and I shall understand with a perfect heart.

text.la: Dómine, magnus es tu, * et præclárus in virtúte tua.
text.en: O Lord, great art thou * and glorious in thy power.

text.la: Laudábo Deum meum * in vita mea.
text.en: I shall praise the Lord * in my life.

text.la: Beátus vir, qui invéntus est sine mácula, et qui post aurum non ábiit, nec sperávit in pecúnia et thesáuris. Quis est hic, et laudábimus eum? fecit enim mirabília in vita sua.
text.en: Blessed is the rich man that is found without blemish: and that hath not gone after gold, nor put his trust in money nor in treasures. Who is he, and we will praise him? for he hath done wonderful things in his life.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths.

r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God.

text.la: Euge, serve bone * et fidélis, quia in pauca fuísti fidélis, supra multa te constítuam, intra in gáudium Dómini tui.
text.en: Well done, thou good and faithful servant; * thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things; enter thou into the joy of thy Lord.

text.la: Deus, qui ad árdua quæque pro nóminis tui glória et animárum salúte beáto Lauréntio, Confessóri tuo atque Doctóri, spíritum sapiéntiæ et fortitúdinis contulísti: da nobis in eódem spíritu et agénda cognóscere; et cógnita, eius intercessióne, perfícere.
text.en: O Lord, you conferred the spirit of wisdom and fortitude on St. Lawrence, Confessor and teacher of faith, to help him perform difficult tasks for the glory of Your name and for the salvation of souls. At his intercession grant us by the same Spirit the grace to know what we ought to do and the courage to do it.

text.la: Símile est regnum cælórum hómini negotiatóri quærénti bonas margarítas: invénta una pretiósa, dedit ómnia sua, et comparávit eam.
text.en: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchantman seeking goodly pearls, who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

v.la: Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
v.en: Grace is poured into thy lips.

r.la: Proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
r.en: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

text.la: Exáudi nos, Deus, salutáris noster: ut sicut de beátæ Praxédis Vírginis tuæ festivitáte gaudémus; ita piæ devotiónis erudiámur afféctu.
text.en: Graciously hear us, O God of our salvation; that as we rejoice in the festivity of blessed Praxedes thy Virgin, we may be instructed in the affections of a loving devotion.

office.title: S. Laurentii a Brundusio Confessoris et Ecclesiæ Doctoris
